query:
INSERT INTO inventory (id, item_id, qty_available, qty_reserved, uom_id)
           VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $1, GREATEST(0::numeric, $2), 0, $3)
           ON CONFLICT (item_id)
           DO UPDATE SET qty_available = GREATEST(0::numeric, inventory.qty_available + $2),
                         last_updated = NOW()
